problem_type: Meta-research audit of public human microbiome data/metadata reusability for AI (systematic PRISMA-guided review with tiering framework)
setting: Published human microbiome studies 2012-2025 and their repository deposits
datasets: 23,781 papers screened; 2,896 studies scored into BHAM tiers; ~720,097 samples
stats: Multinomial logistic regression; binary logistic regression on publication year; Holm correction
realworld: no (policy recommendation; standalone tier-checking tool released)
novelty: Provides the first decade-long, sample-level audit quantifying how little human microbiome sequence data is reusable for cross-cohort AI, with a tiered metadata standard.
metrics: Proportion of studies/samples per reusability tier; odds ratios / relative risk ratios over time

problem_type: Genome-scale metabolic modeling (reactobiome profiling, community FBA/FVA, host models) of paired oral-gut metagenomes
setting: Liver cirrhosis patients across severity (MELD) groups
datasets: GLA cohort (ENA PRJEB52891), RIFSYS cohort (PRJEB38481), healthy controls (PRJEB38483); independent TIPS cohort for validation; sample sizes in Supplement (UNVERIFIED)
n_coh: 2 (minimum: discovery + independent TIPS cohort; exact count UNVERIFIED)
stats: Kruskal-Wallis; pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum; linear regression (R2)
cross: yes (translocating species re-detected in independent cohort)
novelty: Moves oral-gut translocation in cirrhosis from taxonomy to predicted metabolic function, linking translocating species to ammonia production via metabolic modeling.
metrics: Oral-gut metabolic distance (Bray-Curtis on reactobiome), predicted metabolite fluxes, association with MELD

problem_type: Population-scale microbiome-host factor association and derivation of a microbiome health (balance) score
setting: 6,423 reproductive-age women from 18 Chinese provinces, with longitudinal follow-up
datasets: CALM2004 cohort (GSA-human HRA010936, n=6,423); 13 external vaginal microbiome case-control studies for score extrapolation
stats: PERMANOVA; linear and logistic regression; generalized additive model; sliding-window t-test; FDR correction
cross: yes (balance score extrapolated to 13 external datasets)
novelty: Largest East Asian vaginal microbiome survey, revealing an age-40 transition and a balance score that predicts later reproductive-tract outcomes.
metrics: Variance explained (R2), FDR-adjusted associations, balance-score group differences, associations with follow-up outcomes

problem_type: Bioinformatics tool: prediction of prophage induction mode (SOS-dependent vs independent) from LexA binding heterology index
setting: Bacterial genomes from public databases; wet-lab induction validation
datasets: 49,333 complete bacterial genomes (RefSeq-derived); E. coli LexA binding reference set (n=24); experimental test set (n=10 prophages)
n_coh: 3 (reference binding set, test set, genome survey)
stats: 95% confidence interval for accuracy; group comparisons with p-values (test named in Supplement; UNVERIFIED)
novelty: Introduces a tool that classifies prophage induction modes and shows SOS-independent prophages are widespread with distinct genomic traits.

problem_type: Interpretable ML (random forest) predicting enhancer-promoter interactions from DNA replication timing
setting: Human cell lines incl. leukemia; multiple chromatin-interaction technologies
datasets: Hi-C, Hi-TrAC, ChIA-PET, 5C and replication-timing data across six cell lines (+ general model); Zenodo 11398547
n_base: UNVERIFIED (compared with several EPI predictors incl. Lollipop; full list in Supplementary Fig. S6)
stats: NA in main text
novelty: Shows replication timing alone can predict enhancer-promoter interactions with interpretable features, revealing leukemia-specific loops.

problem_type: Database / web platform for quorum-sensing and quenching bacteria and communication network analysis
setting: Activated sludge of wastewater treatment plants worldwide
datasets: Global activated sludge microbiome (NCBI PRJNA509305): >1,000 samples from 269 WWTPs in 23 countries; curated local QS/QQ gene database
stats: NA in main text (network and coefficient-of-variation analyses)
novelty: Builds a global quorum-sensing communication map and online platform for WWTP microbiomes.
metrics: Relative abundance, occurrence frequency, network properties

problem_type: Single-cell computational framework assigning disease-risk index to cells; ML prediction of disease state
setting: Human pancreatic islets across nondiabetic, prediabetic and type 2 diabetes donors
datasets: Integrated scRNA-seq meta-analysis: 495,945 islet cells from 106 donors (49 ND, 23 preT2D, 34 T2D); 4 external validation datasets
n_coh: 5 (integrated discovery + 4 external datasets; number of source studies in discovery UNVERIFIED)
stats: Two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum with Benjamini-Hochberg; Pearson correlation
novelty: Quantifies disease-perturbed risk beta cells along the T2D continuum and uses their proportion as a staging biomarker.

problem_type: Prospective multi-omics cohort with ML prognostic modeling plus FMT mouse validation
setting: Coronary artery disease patients (PUMCH-CAD cohort), median 1.85-year follow-up for MACE
datasets: 319 participants with fecal metagenomics and serum metabolomics (GSA-human HRA010791); ApoE-/- mouse FMT
stats: PERMANOVA/Adonis; Kaplan-Meier; C-index; correlation analyses
realworld: no (FMT in mice as causal evidence)
novelty: Links CAD-severity gut microbial features and aromatic amino acid metabolism to future MACE and shows transmissible atherosclerosis susceptibility.

problem_type: Web platform + benchmark of sequence-based antigenic prediction methods and antigenic mapping
setting: Influenza A surveillance (H1, H3, H5 subtypes)
datasets: HA1 sequences (GISAID) and HI titers (Crick WIC reports; Smith et al.) for H1, H3, H5

n_seeds: NA (cross-validation and retrospective partitions; details in Supplement S5)
stats: NA in main text
novelty: Unifies preprocessing, ten antigenic predictors with a benchmark, and improved antigenic maps in one online platform.

problem_type: Cloud platform update (software/resource description)
setting: Microbiome multi-omics analysis service
datasets: NA (platform; demonstration workflows)

problem_type: Integrative re-analysis of public scRNA-seq and multi-site metagenome/metatranscriptome data plus Mendelian randomization
setting: Astronauts before/after spaceflight vs. natural ageing cohort
datasets: PBMC scRNA-seq (ageing cohort, astronauts); gut/oral/skin metagenomes at six flight time points; sizes in Supplement (UNVERIFIED)
n_coh: 2 (minimum: ageing cohort + astronaut cohort; data from multiple databases, UNVERIFIED)
stats: Differential expression/abundance testing, Mendelian randomization (details in Supplement)
novelty: Argues spaceflight shifts microbiota in ways that partly counter ageing signatures while immune changes mimic ageing.

setting: Periodontitis vs healthy, oral microbiome, 5 countries / 3 continents

n_base: 0 (single RF; taxonomic vs functional vs combined feature sets compared)
stats: Spearman correlation; consistency of biomarkers across >=3 cohorts; sample-cumulation modeling

problem_type: Genome-guild (co-abundance network) biomarker model + random forest classification/prediction
setting: Liver tumors (HCC, iCCA, CRLM, benign); recurrence and anti-PD-1/TACE response
datasets: Cohort 1: 120 HCC + 76 benign (PRJNA1372073/PRJNA1372070); Cohort 2: 33 HCC vs 7 CRLM; external cohort: 76 CTR, 25 HCC, 19 iCCA; treatment cohorts from Xin et al. and Zhao et al.
stats: PERMANOVA; Mann-Whitney U with Benjamini-Hochberg; Procrustes analysis
cross: yes (external cohort; transfer across tumor types)
novelty: Uses stable competing genome guilds instead of taxa to obtain transferable gut microbiome signatures for liver tumor class and treatment outcome.

problem_type: Text-mining meta-analysis with new aggregation algorithm (BHWA) and network analysis; web resource
setting: Dietary fibers, gut microbiota disturbance and human diseases
datasets: 10,899 evidence entries from 1,173 articles; 32 dietary fibers; 161 diseases; plus validation experiments
stats: Pearson correlation; FDR; randomization tests; repeated-measures ANOVA
novelty: Proposes a taxonomy-weighted aggregation of literature-reported microbiota disturbances to map fiber-disease relationships.

problem_type: Microbial co-abundance network inference and random-effects meta-analysis across regions, with replication
setting: Hypertension in Guangdong Gut Microbiome Project (14 regions)
datasets: GGMP (ENA PRJEB18535): 2,355 hypertensive + 4,644 non-hypertensive; replication: 281 hypertension samples (GMLP + Australian cohort)
n_seeds: 20 iterations x 100 bootstrap resamples per network
stats: Random-effects meta-analysis; FDR; heterogeneity analysis; differential co-abundance testing
novelty: Shows non-differentially abundant microbes contribute to hypertension through replicable co-abundance interactions.
metrics: Number of replicated significant co-abundances, effect sizes

problem_type: ML ensemble method/R package (genetic algorithm + 50 base learners) for immunotherapy response prediction
setting: Pan-cancer immune checkpoint blockade cohorts
datasets: 11 RNA-seq ICB cohorts (1,242 subjects, 6 cancer types); TCGA 9,815 patients (30 cohorts); 7 CRISPR screen cohorts; in-house ICB cohort (n=14)
stats: Multivariable logistic regression; ROC; univariate Cox regression
realworld: yes (Shiny web tool; in-house clinical cohort)
novelty: Combines gene-pair features with a GA-optimized ensemble to predict ICB response better than existing signatures.

problem_type: Benchmark of spatial clustering methods
setting: Spatially resolved transcriptomics across technologies, organs and replicates
datasets: ~600 real and simulated datasets (10x Visium, MERFISH, seqFISH+, STARmap etc.)
